cards.question: match HTTP status
cards.task: Функция status_label(code: int) -> str через match: 200->'OK', 404->'Not Found', иначе 'Unknown'.
cards.reference:
def status_label(code: int) -> str:
    match code:
        case 200:
            return 'OK'
        case 404:
            return 'Not Found'
        case _:
            return 'Unknown'

cards.question: partition evens odds
cards.task: Функция partition(numbers: list[int]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]] — чётные и нечётные.
cards.reference:
def partition(numbers: list[int]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
    evens = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]
    odds = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]
    return evens, odds
